تبتدعين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِعِينَ (tabtadiʕīna) /tab.ta.di.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# تُبْتَدَعِينَ (tubtadaʕīna) /tub.ta.da.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
